image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a grey whale's head and upper torso emerging vertically from choppy, teal-green ocean water. The whale's skin is dark grey to black with distinctive white mottling and barnacle clusters, particularly on the rostrum and lower jaw. The background shows a calm horizon line with a faint landmass under an overcast sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The angle of the photo (frontal/vertical emergence) obscures the top of the head where the blowholes are located. While the rostrum shape is visible, the specific feature of 'two blowholes' cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays the characteristic mottled pattern with high-contrast white patches (barnacles/cyamids) against dark grey skin, matching the species description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image only captures the anterior portion (head/chest) of the whale. The posterior back where dorsal knuckles would be located is submerged or out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and immediate shoulder area are visible. The full spindle shape and total proportions cannot be assessed from this cropped view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint, the visible skin texture and coloration on the upper body match the expected mottled grey and white barnacle distribution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The whale's mouth is closed. Baleen plates are internal structures not visible in this external shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pectoral fins are located further down the body and are completely submerged/out of frame in this vertical breach shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is entirely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-resolution details on the snout show raised, rough textures consistent with callosities and barnacle attachments.

artifact_observations.location: Water surface around the whale's base
artifact_observations.reasoning: The water interaction at the contact point between the whale and the sea lacks realistic displacement foam or spray. The transition appears slightly soft and 'painted,' suggesting minor generative smoothing rather than physical fluid dynamics.
The horizon line exhibits a very subtle, unnatural curvature that doesn't align perfectly with the camera lens perspective, though it is barely noticeable.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification of species identity based on unique skin mottling and head shape.
To critically assess the realism of the water displacement and edge blending which showed minor anomalies.
To ensure the barnacle patterns are structurally connected to the skin and not floating artifacts.
To verify the depth consistency between the foreground whale and the background horizon.

focus_areas: Water displacement physics at contact point
Edge sharpness between subject and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the water interaction. AI often fails to render realistic splash/foam when large objects emerge from water. Verify if the 'mottling' is consistent with biological barnacle placement or if it looks like random noise overlay.
